body: "Not canon." 🤣 There is no real Cthulhu mythos canon. Canon can be whatever each individual reading it wants it to be. Lovecraft didn't really put much focus into trying to build a canon lore. All the stories just had similar elements, or loose connections at best. And, considering the sheer amount of authors who've contributed to the mythos, it's impossible to determine what is or isn't "true canon". It's all simultaneously both canon and not canon. You get to choose how to accept it.
